title: The Fandom Glossary
subject: one-direction
author: Clueberry Desk
introduction: Nine words that a fan would not have to look up.

entries.clue: Platform where fan fiction about the group piled up
Pair two people off, in fan talk
Blogging site where much of the community gathered
Name a fan of the band answers to
Collective noun for the whole lot of them

factCards.text: Anna Todd's novel After started life as One Direction fan fiction serialised on Wattpad, and was published in print by Gallery Books in 2014.
Directioner became the standard self-description for fans from around 2011, spreading through Twitter and Tumblr rather than from any official announcement.
factCards.sourceTitle: Fan-community usage; no single dated source establishes the coinage

factCards.text: To ship, short for relationship, is general fandom vocabulary for wanting two figures to be a couple; it predates this fandom by well over a decade.
factCards.sourceTitle: Oxford English Dictionary entry for ship (verb)
